name: evisa-flow
description: Automated UK eVisa share code + PDF retrieval via Playwright.

scripts.build:lib: tsup src/index.ts src/cli.ts src/unstable/testing.ts --format esm --sourcemap --clean && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declarationMap false
scripts.build:service: pnpm run build:lib && pnpm --filter evisa-flow-bot build
scripts.dev: tsup src/index.ts src/cli.ts src/unstable/testing.ts --format esm --sourcemap --clean --watch --onSuccess "tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declarationMap false"
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:built
scripts.test:service: pnpm run build:lib && pnpm --filter evisa-flow-bot build && node --test service/tests/*.test.js
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:lib && pnpm run typecheck:service
scripts.typecheck:service: pnpm run build:lib && pnpm --filter evisa-flow-bot typecheck
scripts.validate: pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:toolchain && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:built && pnpm run pack:dry && pnpm run audit

author: Ramzan Bekbulatov
